description: Source file implementing the CdmService and CdmFactoryImpl classes for managing Content Decryption Modules (CDMs) via Mojo IPC in the media namespace.

classes.name: CdmFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of mojom::CdmFactory that creates and manages MojoCdmService instances and their associated CDMs, handling their lifecycle and IPC communication.

methods.name: CreateCdm
methods.description: Creates a new Content Decryption Module (CDM) instance based on the provided configuration and invokes the callback with the result.

methods.name: OnDestroyPending
methods.description: Handles deferred destruction of the CdmFactoryImpl instance when all receivers are disconnected.

methods.name: GetCdmFactory
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the media::CdmFactory instance used to create CDMs.

methods.name: OnReceiverDisconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection of Mojo receivers, potentially triggering cleanup.

methods.name: OnCdmServiceInitialized
methods.description: Callback invoked when a MojoCdmService has been initialized, to finalize the CDM setup or handle errors.
